en: Vintage black-and-white postcard with a panoramic illustration of a cityscape showing dense low-rise buildings on a hillside, a wide avenue with pedestrians and horse-drawn vehicles, and scattered trees. In the foreground is a decorative circular frame around part of the view. The word "Salonique" appears prominently as a title, with additional printed and handwritten French text below, resembling a typical early 20th‑century correspondence postcard.
